name: Session<S> / KernelCtx

test_list.description: Composition retains underlying storage transient/permanent/fatal classifications.
A bus subscriber sees the same assigned record already committed to redb.
Rebuild a removed synthetic catalogue from configuration CAS and events.
A corrupt CAS blob rejects recovery without appending an event.
Reject a resume injected after archive without a pause/reopen transition.
A corrupt registry aborts startup and releases the redb owner lock.
An actual SQLite abort trigger produces ProjectionBehind while retaining committed state.
More than 256 interleaved session records replay in bounded pages without setting leakage.
For generated override histories, recovered state equals the last override or immutable default.
Persist immutable configuration and typed defaults before startup.
Pause and resume commit explicit lifecycle records and update the registry.
Reopen after dropping/reopening real databases restores last-wins session directives.
Each session starts from its own immutable defaults.
Reject duplicate mutable owners and permit reopen after the owner drops.
A crashed running session is durably paused before returning a recovery handle.
An incomplete startup cannot masquerade as a running or paused session.
Do not admit sessions until prior resources are safely reconciled.
Reject nonexistent workspaces and blank names before any event append.
Root shutdown rejects later directive writes.
Invalid typestate mutations fail to compile.

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.description: Workspace, display name, Git metadata and typed directive defaults.

output_description: Exclusively owned session with durable lifecycle, replay and rebuildable registry projection.
